title: Reservation capacity-source revision selection request
upstream: FOOD-007C exact SKU source read as future consumer only.
FOOD-007D exact slot source read as future consumer only.

input.capture: Recursively detach plain own data before upstream validation; reject unexpected prototypes, accessors, symbols, cycles, unsupported primitives, sparse arrays and extra array properties. No trimming/coercion.

skuMapping: Exactly one selection { sku: { id, version }, revision } for every exact demand SKU. Reject missing/extra/duplicate/wrong-id/wrong-version selections. Match by identity, never position alone.
outputOrdering: Canonical SKU selections follow validated request demand line order regardless of caller selection order.
slotMapping: Exact method/locationReference/windowReference/revision keys. Slot identity must equal validated intent. References are nonempty unpadded strings up to 512 characters.
revisionSemantics: Positive safe integers including historical values and maximum safe integer. No existence, continuity, latest, currentness, eligibility or capacity test.
quoteRetention: Quote is a structural validation input only; not duplicated in output. Output is not authenticated provenance evidence.
immutability: Result, candidate, snapshots, selection identities, selection array and slot selection are detached and deeply frozen. Caller objects remain mutable.
persistence: None. No storage readers, routes or acceptance constructors.
safeClaim: A complete set of proposed exact capacity-source revision references is structurally bound to the supplied reservation demand and fulfillment intent.
next: Discover/implement proposed revision resolution and/or eligibility policy before operational capacity accounting.
